theorem targetCone_of_tilt {F a c : ℝ} (hF : 0 < F) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hv : 2 < a * (1 + (c / a) ^ 2)) (T : Plane) (hT : 0 < T 0)
    (hin : 0 < 1 + (c / a) * (T 1 / T 0))
    (hgap : 0 < 2 * (1 + (c / a) * (T 1 / T 0)) ^ 2 -
      (a * (1 + (c / a) ^ 2) - 2) * (T 1 / T 0 - c / a) ^ 2) :
    PrimaryRepresentatives.TargetCone F (F • !₂[-a, -c]) T
